description: Gives what Watches in Stock has published about itself and its buying terms: how buying works, the 10% deposit, authenticity, how prices are set and the commission in them, availability, selling, consignment, where listings come from, shipping, returns, warranty, payment, and how customer details are used. Use it for questions about the business rather than a particular watch, including whether the store is legitimate, who the customer would pay, whether a watch can be held and how to pay, and quote its words rather than general trade practice.
name: store_info
title: How Watches in Stock works
